selection: Prior repetition candidates chosen before fresh inference; all frozen sources and unavailable cuts retained. Gallery selected from outcomes. Counts describe this enriched pool; cohorts have separate pairing rules.
criterion: All four exact same-image replays; at least one 1/2/3-copy clear-image suffix has >=90% matching, <=15% character edits, natural end and no severe loop; the 5-copy suffix has <=40% matching and loops to the output limit.

cohorts.verification: Record hashes, image hashes, tokenizer decoding, actual prefix IDs, exact512-decision same-image replay, independent character alignment, all exclusions and completion checked.
cohorts.pairing_rule: New sources only; pair text similarity and normalized annotation edit similarity >=90%. Recorded pair eligibility flags retained. A unique shared pre-loop anchor and >=94% future-reference agreement are required for a branch. Original images require visual review for showcased cases.
